researchAssessment.meaning: Local component and design reference; not a complete exporter or an approved product integration

openFindings: Default registered CLI omits favorites and likes; the studied exporter also expects unsupported streaming flags and NDJSON.
read with bare ID plus explicit token can overwrite a cached pc_search source with pc_feed; live impact remains untested.
Desktop HTML parsing can fall back to a different note while wrapping the requested outer ID.
Saved-session import and diagnostics do not enforce the user's expected stable account ID.
Some diagnostic fingerprints, QR logs and failure messages retain session material; ordinary Set-Cookie updates are process-local.
Cookie, access-token and search-session caches are not durable per-post export progress or media receipts.
Current platform compatibility, completeness and long-term stability were not tested.
